subject: In methylkit how is average conversion rate calculated or formaula for calculation average conversion rates?

messages.author: a16120fa982106ba
messages.subject: In methylkit how is average conversion rate calculated or formaula for calculation average conversion rates?
parts:
My question is whether average conversion rates given by methylkit = bisulfite conversion rate?
here is the output:
total otherC considered (>95% C+T): 28609
average conversion rate = 2.99096846542875
total otherC considered (Forward) (>95% C+T): 14623
average conversion rate (Forward) = 2.87848191283719
total otherC considered (Reverse) (>95% C+T): 13986
average conversion rate (Reverse) = 3.10857827942463

Since i wanted to calculate bisulfite conversion rate? please help me with a suitable reply.

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] In methylkit how is average conversion rate calculated or formaula for calculation average conversion rates?
parts:
This is one way estimating conversion rate, a more accurate conversion rate can be obtained via spike-ins in the experiment but many papers report this or similar values as bisulfite conversion rate, and general idea of conversion rate has been explained before:
https://groups.google.com/d/msg/methylkit_discussion/A5_LeS8y3Ks/lFect-XFJ3kJ

Please consider using search function in the forum, you will find that many questions are already answered in the forum.

Best,
Altuna
